where.if: and (e.emp_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.emp_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.email, e.emp_no, e.phone, e.dept_id, e.job_code, e.salary, e.bonus, e.manager_id, e.hire_date, e.ent_date, e.ent_yn, d.dept_title as dept_name, j.job_name as job_name from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id left join job j on e.job_code = j.job_code
order by ${orderByClause} limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.email, e.hire_date, e.ent_yn, d.dept_title as dept_name from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id order by e.hire_date desc limit #{limit}

select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.email, e.emp_no, e.phone, e.dept_id, e.job_code, e.salary, e.bonus, e.manager_id, e.hire_date, e.ent_date, e.ent_yn, d.dept_title as dept_name, j.job_name as job_name, m.emp_name as manager_name, n.national_name as location_name,
sg.sal_level as sal_grade, sg.min_sal as sal_grade_min, sg.max_sal as sal_grade_max, timestampdiff(year, e.hire_date, ifnull(e.ent_date, curdate())) as years_of_service from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id left join job j on e.job_code = j.job_code left join emp m on e.manager_id = m.emp_id left join location l on d.location_id = l.local_code left join national n on l.national_code = n.national_code left join sal_grade sg on e.salary between sg.min_sal and sg.max_sal where e.emp_id = #{id}
select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.manager_id, j.job_name as job_name from emp e left join job j on e.job_code = j.job_code where e.manager_id = #{managerId} order by e.emp_id
mapper.insert: insert into emp (emp_id, emp_name, email, emp_no, phone, dept_id, job_code, salary, bonus, manager_id, hire_date, ent_yn) values (#{empId}, #{empName}, #{email}, #{empNo}, #{phone}, #{deptId}, #{jobCode}, #{salary}, #{bonus}, #{managerId}, #{hireDate}, #{entYn})
mapper.update: update emp set emp_name = #{empName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, dept_id = #{deptId}, job_code = #{jobCode}, salary = #{salary}, bonus = #{bonus}, manager_id = #{managerId}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, ent_yn = #{entYn} where emp_id = #{empId}
